BS19-067.effect:

SJ18-08.name: The ExplosionHeroGodKing Execeed-Bazzel
SJ18-08.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Emperor Beast & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Or, stack it via [Advent].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, at the end of a blocked battle, you can send two opposing Lives to their Reserve. Also, you can immediately activate one of your Bursts.

Destroy every opposing Nexus. For each Nexus destroyed by this effect, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending this Spirit's [Soul Core](Soul Core) to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.

Increase the limit of your"BP Destruction effects" by +1000.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't use Purple/White/Yellow Magic cards. By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, also, destroy up to two opposing Cost 6 or less Spirits.

SJ15-19.name: The SengokuBeastEmperor Souldragon-Flame
SJ15-19.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
If your Life is three or less, summon any number of "Souldragon"-named Spirit cards from your Hand without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, also, destroy up to two opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits.

SJ15-09.name: The WarParamount AshuraDragon

By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit to your Trash, destroy one of your Spirits, and add all of that Spirit's BP and symbols to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Ultimate Trooper" family Spirit is destroyed, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
